answer: A per-identity stake bond plus a proof-of-work floor makes each seat expensive before it can speak. Sybils must fund thousands of bonds in parallel, so cost grows linearly with the swarm while per-replica voting weight stays flat, and a bonding curve lifts marginal price as one wallet stacks identities. A shared thread of attestations forces platoons of clones in one meadow to self-vouch under the same fee twice, and each staged voyage through reviewable epochs exposes them to slashing before rewards arrive.
